name: XLA_FSN_BAL_HEADERS_GT
description: This table is used by the Accounting Engine to perform intercompany balancing.

columns.name: AE_HEADER_ID
columns.description: Accounting entry identifier to be balanced.

columns.name: LEDGER_ID
columns.description: Self-contained accounting information set for single or multiple legal or management entities.

columns.name: JE_CATEGORY_NAME
columns.description: Journal category of the accounting entry.

columns.name: ACCOUNTING_DATE
columns.description: Date, that is referenced from Oracle Fusion General Ledger, used to determine the accounting period for transactions.

columns.name: PERIOD_NAME
columns.description: Period that contains the accounting entry.

columns.name: CHART_OF_ACCOUNTS_ID
columns.description: Chart of accounts identifier of the primary or reporting currency ledger owned by the accounting entry.

columns.name: LGR_CURRENCY_CODE
columns.description: Currency of the primary or reporting currency ledger owned by the accounting entry.

columns.name: EVENT_NUMBER
columns.description: Event number of the event owned by the accounting entry.

columns.name: MAX_LINE_NUM
columns.description: Maximum line number used in this accounting entry.

columns.name: NEED_BAL_CODE
columns.description: Indicates whether intercompany is necessary.  Also, indicates whether this is a transaction reversal or transaction line reversal. N: No intercompany, Y: Intercompany.

columns.name: PARTITION_GROUP_CODE
columns.description: Partition grouping information which determines the database partition in which large accounting entries will be stored temporarily for processing by the accounting engine.
